text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mubarak holds important talks in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia during Arabian tour aimed at saving Middle East peace process.
- Cabinet approves investment projects in new five-year plan and draft budget plan.
- Museveni leaves Cairo after talks; Egypt and Uganda agreed to boost cooperation in fields of economy and agriculture.
- Turkish president arrives in Cairo on Monday.
- Cooperative Agriculture Union wants to liberalise cotton trade this year.
- Oil Ministry to sign this month first agreement with Egyptian private company for oil and natural gas exploration and production in central Sinai.
- Government to announce soon terms of early retirement package for women public sector employees.
